P_s2.explanation: The unit detects small dark dots on a lighter surface: dark eyes and noses on pale faces (dogs, toys, dolls, Danbo boxes, polar bear), ladybird spots, holes in ocarinas, pegboard and drilled brake discs, and speckles on fruit or butterfly wings. parsed.evidence: Red boxes sit on dot-like features across unrelated object categories, such as perforated metal, ladybirds and face eyes. parsed.missing_data: Synthetic stimuli would help most: dark dots on light backgrounds compared with light dots on dark backgrounds, at different dot sizes and spacings, to test whether faces add anything beyond the dot pattern.
